name: interplanetary-fund
description: Interplanetary Fund — full-stack app with agents, protocol enforcement, treasury management, and external platform sync. Frontend: React + Vite. Backend: Convex. Credit-free.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.mobile:build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
